content.json:
---
### Optional: SOAR automation inputs

The selectors below are optional. Set **Subscriptions**, **Resource groups**, and **Logic Apps** only if you want to estimate SOAR/Logic App automation costs in the SOAR summary section further down. Microsoft Sentinel Data Lake costs cannot be estimated from Log Analytics `Usage` data, so no additional parameters are needed for the Data Lake section.

items.name: text - optional SOAR and Data Lake inputs

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type in~ ({ResourceTypes})
| summarize Count = count() by subscriptionId
| order by Count desc
| extend Rank = row_number()
| project value = subscriptionId, label = subscriptionId, selected = Rank == 1

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type in~ ({ResourceTypes})
| summarize Count = count() by subscriptionId, resourceGroup
| order by Count desc
| extend Rank = row_number()
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/', resourceGroup), label = resourceGroup, selected = false

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.label: Logic Apps
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type in~({ResourceTypes})
| extend resourceGroupId = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/', resourceGroup)
| where resourceGroupId in~({ResourceGroups}) or '*' in~({ResourceGroups})
| order by name asc
| extend Rank = row_number()
| project value = id, label = tostring(name), selected = Rank <= 10, group = resourceGroup

## Free Sentinel Data Summary

Microsoft documents the following Sentinel data sources as free:

- Azure Activity Logs (`AzureActivity`)
- Health monitoring for Microsoft Sentinel (`SentinelHealth`)
- Microsoft 365 audit activity (`OfficeActivity`)
- Microsoft Entra ID Protection alerts (`SecurityAlert`)
- Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Defender for IoT alerts (`SecurityAlert`)
- Microsoft Defender XDR incidents and alerts (`SecurityIncident`, `SecurityAlert`)
- Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, and Office 365 alerts (`SecurityAlert`)

This section estimates Analytics-tier ingestion in the selected workspace scope and keeps it separate from billable ingestion. It does not estimate data lake-only ingestion, storage, processing, or query charges. Usage is grouped by table and cannot reliably identify the originating connector, so `SecurityAlert` cannot be allocated reliably among its contributing services. This estimate does not calculate the separate Sentinel free trial. Review the [Microsoft Sentinel free data sources](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/billing?tabs=simplified%2Ccommitment-tiers#free-data-sources) documentation for current eligibility and billing terms.

## Microsoft Sentinel benefit for Microsoft 365 E7/E5/A5/F5/G5 customers

Qualifying Microsoft 365 E7, E5, A5, F5, and G5 licenses, and corresponding Security licenses, may receive a Microsoft Sentinel data grant of up to 5 MB per qualifying user per day for eligible Microsoft 365 data.

Eligible data-source groups include:

- Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit logs (`SigninLogs`, `AuditLogs`, `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs`, `AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs`, `AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs`, `AADProvisioningLogs`, `ADFSSignInLogs`, `AADUserRiskEvents`, `AADRiskyUsers`)
- Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps Guard shadow IT discovery logs (`McasShadowItReporting`)
- Microsoft Purview Information Protection logs (`InformationProtectionLogs_CL`)
- Microsoft 365 advanced hunting data (the eligible `Device*`, `Email*`, `Identity*`, `AlertEvidence`, and `CloudAppEvents` tables shown below)

This workbook estimates the Analytics-tier ingestion benefit from billable Usage data in the selected workspace scope. It does not estimate data lake-only charges or prove that a row came from an eligible connector, that the offer applies to your agreement, or that the calculated amount matches billing. The grant cap is modeled once across the selected scope; it is not multiplied per workspace.

Review the [Microsoft 365 Sentinel benefit offer](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/offers/sentinel-microsoft-365-offer/) for current eligibility, agreement terms, and supported data types. Enter **Total Microsoft 365 E7/E5/A5/F5/G5 seats** and **Ingestion price** above to calculate the estimate.

## Microsoft Sentinel benefit for Defender for Servers Plan 2

Defender for Servers Plan 2 provides up to 500 MB of eligible Analytics-tier ingestion per protected server or node per day. The allowance is pooled across machines in each subscription and applied at workspace level. This workbook estimates observed usage; it does not prove Plan 2 protection, licensing, eligibility, or data lake-only charges.

Core eligible tables:

- `SecurityAlert`, `SecurityBaseline`, `SecurityBaselineSummary`, `SecurityDetection`, `SecurityEvent`
- `WindowsFirewall`, `ProtectionStatus`, `MDCFileIntegrityMonitoringEvents`
- `DeviceCustomFileEvents`, `DeviceCustomRegistryEvents`

Conditionally eligible tables:

- `Update`, `UpdateSummary`: review the applicable Update Management conditions
- `WindowsEvent`: only security data from the Microsoft-SecurityEvent stream

Nodes is the distinct `Computer` count observed in `Heartbeat`, not proof of licensing or Plan 2 protection. Review the [Defender for Servers Plan 2 data ingestion benefit](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/data-ingestion-benefit) for current eligibility and terms.
Enter the number of protected Defender for Servers Plan 2 servers or nodes above to calculate the daily and total data grants, grant usage, and estimated cost savings.

## Retention summary

This section estimates Analytics-tier charges for billable data retained longer than 90 days, using historical billable workspace records. XDR and data lake retention use separate billing models. Review [Manage data tiers and retention in Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/manage-data-overview) for retention and data-tier guidance.

content.query: let retainedDataGB = toreal(coalesce(toscalar((union withsource = SourceTableName * | where TimeGenerated < startofday(now()) - 90d | where _IsBillable == true | summarize sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0)), 0.0)); print ['Average Daily Retention Cost'] = retainedDataGB * todouble('{RetentionPrice}') / 30.0
content.title: Average Daily Retention Cost

## Microsoft Sentinel Data Lake

The data lake provides long-term, cost-effective storage outside the Analytics tier. Its costs are billed separately for data lake ingestion, processing, storage, query, and advanced data insights. Microsoft Defender XDR data also has separate 30-day default and extended-retention pricing.

Data lake charges are not available from the Log Analytics `Usage` table, so this workbook cannot calculate billing-accurate data lake costs. Review current usage and costs in **Microsoft Sentinel > Cost management** in the Microsoft Defender portal. Learn more in the [Microsoft Sentinel data lake overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/datalake/sentinel-lake-overview) and [Manage and monitor costs for Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/billing-monitor-costs). Review current data lake rates on the [Microsoft Sentinel pricing page](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/pricing/microsoft-sentinel/).

## Commitment tiers

Microsoft Sentinel and Log Analytics offer Pay-As-You-Go and Commitment Tier pricing (100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 2000, and 5000+ GB/day). This section is fully automatic: it detects your **current commitment tier** from the selected workspace configuration and calculates a **recommended tier** from your average billable daily ingestion over the selected time range. No additional input is required.

Commitment tier changes typically require a minimum 31-day commitment before switching again — review **Days since tier last changed** before making a change. Actual per-GB rates vary by region, currency, and agreement type and change over time, so this workbook cannot calculate exact savings. Confirm current rates on the [Microsoft Sentinel pricing page](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/pricing/microsoft-sentinel/) and review [Plan costs and understand pricing and billing for Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/billing?tabs=simplified%2Ccommitment-tiers#analytics-tier) before changing your commitment tier.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| where id in~ ({Workspace}) or 'value::all' in~ ({Workspace})
| extend skuName = tostring(properties.sku.name), capacityReservationLevel = toint(properties.sku.capacityReservationLevel), lastSkuUpdate = todatetime(properties.sku.lastSkuUpdate)
| extend daysSinceTierChange = iif(isnotempty(lastSkuUpdate), datetime_diff('day', now(), lastSkuUpdate), int(null))
| project ['Workspace'] = name, ['Current commitment tier'] = case(skuName == 'CapacityReservation', strcat(tostring(capacityReservationLevel), ' GB/day commitment'), isnotempty(skuName), skuName, 'Unknown'), ['Days since tier last changed'] = daysSinceTierChange
| order by ['Workspace'] asc
content.title: Current commitment tier by workspace (auto-detected)
content.noDataMessage: No workspace SKU information was found for the selected workspace scope.

content.json:
## SOAR summary

Microsoft Sentinel playbooks use Azure Logic Apps to automate responses to incidents, alerts, and other security operations workflows. This section summarizes billable Logic App executions across accessible playbooks and estimates their execution cost using the **Logic App execution cost** input at the top of the workbook.

To populate this estimate, export the `TotalBillableExecutions` metric to the selected Log Analytics workspace and use the Analytics plan for the `AzureMetrics` table. Basic Logs tables cannot run this query. The estimate is not an invoice; use Azure Cost Management to validate billed charges.

Review [Automate threat response with playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/automation/automate-responses-with-playbooks) for playbook guidance. Because playbooks use Azure Logic Apps, additional charges can apply. Go to the [Azure Logic Apps](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/logic-apps/) pricing page for more details.

content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where MetricName == 'TotalBillableExecutions' | where ResourceId in~ ({Resources}) or 'value::all' in~ ({Resources}) | summarize TotalBillableExecutions = sum(Total) | project ['Total billable executions'] = TotalBillableExecutions, ['Estimated automation cost'] = TotalBillableExecutions * todouble('{ExecutionCost}')
content.title: Logic App automation summary
content.noDataMessage: No exported TotalBillableExecutions metrics were found. Configure Logic App metric export to this workspace to calculate the total without selecting a row.

content.query: print ['Estimated automation costs'] = todouble('{Total}') * todouble('{ExecutionCost}')
content.title: Estimated Logic App cost
